verses.1:
These were the sons of Israel:
 Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
verses.2: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.3:
The sons of Judah:
 Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death.
verses.4: Tamar, Judah’s daughter-in-law, bore to him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.
verses.5:
The sons of Perez:
 Hezron and Hamul.
verses.6:
The sons of Zerah:
 Zimri, + 2:6 Zimri is a variant of Zabdi ; see Joshua 7:1|JOS 7:1 . Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara + 2:6 Most Hebrew manuscripts; many Hebrew manuscripts, some LXX manuscripts, and Syriac (see also 1 Kings 4:31|1KI 4:31 ) Darda — five in all.
verses.7:
The son + 2:7 Hebrew sons of Carmi:
 Achar, + 2:7 Achar means troubler ; also called Achan in Joshua 7 and Joshua 22. who brought trouble upon Israel by violating the ban on devoted things.
verses.9:
The sons who were born to Hezron:
 Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb. + 2:9 Hebrew Chelubai , a variant of Caleb ; see verse 18.
verses.10: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of the descendants of Judah.
verses.11: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, + 2:11 LXX (see also Ruth 4:20–21|RUT 4:20-21 ); Hebrew Salma ; twice in this verse and Salmon was the father of Boaz.
verses.12: Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse.
verses.13: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; Abinadab was born second, Shimea + 2:13 Shimea is a variant of Shammah , Shimeah , and Shimei ; see 1 Samuel 16:9|1SA 16:9 , 2 Samuel 13:3, and 2 Samuel 21:21. third,
verses.16: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the three sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
verses.17: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether + 2:17 Jether is a variant of Ithra ; see 2 Samuel 17:25|2SA 17:25 . the Ishmaelite.
verses.18: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah and by Jerioth. These were the sons of Azubah: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.19: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, + 2:19 Ephrath is a variant of Ephrathah ; see verse 50. who bore to him Hur.
verses.20: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.
verses.21: Later, Hezron slept with the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead. He had married her when he was sixty years old, and she bore to him Segub.
verses.22: Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.23: But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth-jair, + 2:23 Or the villages of Jair along with Kenath and its sixty surrounding villages. All these were descendants of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.24: After Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah bore + 2:24 Or After Hezron died, Caleb had relations with Ephrathah, the wife of Hezron his father, and she bore ; see also LXX. to him Ashhur the father + 2:24 Or the founder ; also in verses 42, 45, 49, and possibly elsewhere of Tekoa.
verses.25:
The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron:
 Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.26: Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah, who was the mother of Onam.
verses.27:
The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel:
 Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
verses.28:
The sons of Onam:
 Shammai and Jada.
 The sons of Shammai:
 Nadab and Abishur.
verses.29: Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, and she bore to him Ahban and Molid.
verses.30:
The sons of Nadab:
 Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.
verses.31:
The son + 2:31 Hebrew sons ; three times in this verse of Appaim:
 Ishi.
 The son of Ishi:
 Sheshan.
 The son of Sheshan:
 Ahlai.
verses.32:
The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai:
 Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.
verses.33:
The sons of Jonathan:
 Peleth and Zaza.
 These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.
verses.34: Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. He also had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
verses.35: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore to him Attai.
verses.36: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan was the father of Zabad,
verses.37: Zabad was the father of Ephlal, Ephlal was the father of Obed,
verses.38: Obed was the father of Jehu, Jehu was the father of Azariah,
verses.39: Azariah was the father of Helez, Helez was the father of Elasah,
verses.40: Elasah was the father of Sismai, Sismai was the father of Shallum,
verses.41: Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.
verses.42:
The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel:
 Mesha + 2:42 Hebrew; LXX Mareshah his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and Mareshah his second son, who was the father of Hebron.
verses.43:
The sons of Hebron:
 Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
verses.44: Shema was the father of Raham the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem was the father of Shammai.
verses.45: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
verses.46: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.
verses.47:
The sons of Jahdai:
 Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.48: Caleb’s concubine Maacah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.
verses.49: She was also the mother of Shaaph father of Madmannah, and of Sheva father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Acsah.
verses.50:
These were the descendants of Caleb.
 The sons + 2:50 LXX and Vulgate; Hebrew son of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah: + 2:50 Ephrathah is a variant of Ephrath ; see verse 19. 
 Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim,
verses.51: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
verses.52:
These were the descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim:
 Haroeh, half the Manahathites,
verses.53: and the clans of Kiriath-jearim— the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.
verses.54:
The descendants of Salma:
 Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites,
verses.55: and the clans of the scribes + 2:55 Or of the Sopherites who lived at Jabez— the Tirathites, Shimeathites, and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab. + 2:55 Or the father of Beth-rekab or the founder of the house of Rechab
